name: com.qcat.truchet
description: Procedural GPU-driven Truchet-tile system for Unity: quadtree/regular-grid layouts, multiple rendering backends (GPU instanced, texture, UI), tile cooking pipeline and SDF shader demos.

samples.description: Backend demo scenes: GPU-instanced render, texture render (mesh/UI) for quadtree and regular-grid layouts.
SDF shader-based rendering demos: simple SDF, texture-array SDF (with bake tools), winged multi-scale SDF, ShaderToy port.
